title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management triage agent summaries in Microsoft Defender
summary: The rollout, automatic enablement for qualifying organisations, licensing and portal controls are supported. The page should not assume summaries identify users by name or broadly say Microsoft provides no guidance; the sources leave summary pseudonymisation unresolved and the tenant notice provides readiness guidance.

claims.claim: The cited Learn article about investigating IRM alerts in Defender does not describe agent summaries.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Insider Risk Management" "agent summaries" "Defender"'; opened learn.microsoft.com/defender-xdr/irm-investigate-alerts-defender in full. It covers alerts, incidents, hunting and Graph, but not triage agent summaries.

claims.quote: Select an alert to display the Agent summary and overview details for the alert.

claims.claim: Agent categorisation uses Needs attention and Less urgent.
claims.quote: Agent categorization: Alerts are categorized as Needs attention or Less urgent.

claims.claim: The summaries present context about a named user's activity.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Insider Risk Management" "Defender" "summaries" "pseudonymized"'; read the roadmap, MC1438568, and Learn's Defender investigation and Purview activities articles. They establish user context, not whether Defender summaries expose real names.
claims.fix: Replace "a named user's risky activity" with "a user's risky activity". Keep the existing open question about names versus pseudonyms.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not separately specified whether these roles suffice for viewing the new summaries in Defender.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Insider Risk Management triage agent Defender summaries disable summary roles SCU rate pricing' and '"Insider Risk Management" "agent summaries" "Defender"'; opened Defender investigation and IRM agent get-started articles. Neither specifies Defender summary permissions.

claims.claim: The cited Learn agent pages describe categorisation and summaries rather than actions the agent takes on users or content.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Insider Risk Management" "triage agent" "API" "deactivate"'; opened IRM agent get-started and Purview agents overview in full, and the activities article's Agent summary section. No user/content enforcement action is described there.

claims.claim: The sharing control is under Purview Settings > Insider Risk Management > Data sharing > Sharing data with other Microsoft security solutions.
claims.quote:
In Insider Risk Management settings, select the Data sharing setting.
Under the Sharing data with other Microsoft security solutions section, turn on the setting.
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct section but stops before its toggle. Use "Settings > Insider Risk Management > Data sharing > Sharing data with other Microsoft security solutions > Share user risk details with other security solutions"; the final label is on the already-cited Defender investigation page.

claims.claim: No automation operation for changing the IRM data-sharing setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Insider Risk Management data sharing setting PowerShell API Set-PolicyConfig', '"Insider Risk Management" "Share user risk details" "PowerShell"', and '"Insider Risk Management" "data sharing" "cmdlet"'; opened settings/share-data. Export APIs do not set sharing.

claims.claim: Deactivate agent is reached through Purview Agents > Explore agents > the agent's View agent > ellipsis next to Edit agent > Deactivate agent.
claims.quote:
Select View agent for the agent you want to deactivate. This opens the agent overview page.
On the far right upper right hand corner of the agent overview page, select the ellipses (three dots) that are located next to the Edit agent button.
Select Deactivate agent.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or PowerShell operation to deactivate this Purview IRM triage agent.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Insider Risk Management triage agent deactivate usage monitoring API PowerShell' and '"Insider Risk Management" "triage agent" "API" "deactivate"'; opened IRM agent get-started and agents overview. The documented deactivation procedure is portal-only.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Cost and licensing; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Agent usage monitoring is reached through Purview Agents > Explore agents > View agent > Edit agent > Usage monitoring.
claims.quote:
In the left hand navigation pane, select Agents.
Select Explore agents.
Select View agent for agent you want to edit. This opens the agent overview page.
Select Edit agent. This opens the Edit agent page.
Select Usage monitoring.

claims.claim: The agent-specific usage monitoring row has no documented equivalent automation operation.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Insider Risk Management triage agent deactivate usage monitoring API PowerShell' and '"Insider Risk Management" "triage agent" "usage" "API"'; opened IRM agent get-started and Security Copilot manage-usage. No IRM-agent equivalent operation was found.

claims.claim: Deactivating the agent stops alert triage.
claims.quote: Deactivating the agent stops it from triaging alerts.

claims.claim: Removing the agent resets the alert timeframe reference point.
claims.quote: Removing the agent deletes it from Microsoft Purview and resets the Select Alert timeframe reference point in time.

claims.claim: Deployment, configuration and deactivation require the Purview agent permissions listed in the get-started article.
claims.quote: Assign these roles for setting up the agent using a recommended agent identity, actions like configuring or customizing, or deactivating and removing agents:

claims.claim: Viewing triaged IRM alerts requires the roles listed in the article's dedicated viewing-permissions section.
claims.quote: The account that you use to view the Insider Risk Management triage agent alert activity must be assigned the roles (any one from each group):

claims.claim: The documented Purview Usage monitoring procedure tracks consumption rather than setting a spending cap.
claims.quote: Use the following steps to view security compute unit (SCU) usage for an agent.

claims.claim: IRM alerts in the Defender alert queue can be filtered using Service source.
claims.quote: All insider risk management alerts are also visible in the Microsoft Defender portal's alert queue. Filter these alerts by choosing Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management under Service source.

claims.claim: Learn does not document a Defender switch to hide only agent summaries while retaining IRM alerts.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Insider Risk Management" "triage agent" "Defender" "disable"' and '"Insider Risk Management" "agent summaries" "Defender"'; opened Defender investigation and IRM agent get-started. Neither documents a summary-only Defender switch.

claims.claim: IRM data sharing with other security solutions must be enabled for the Defender integration.
claims.quote: Data sharing with other security solutions must be turned on in the Data sharing settings in Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management.

claims.claim: The Defender article labels the sharing toggle Share user risk details with other security solutions.
claims.quote: Turning on Share user risk details with other security solutions in the Microsoft Purview portal enables users with the correct permissions to review user risk details in the user entity pages in the Microsoft Defender portal.

claims.claim: Investigators can compare alerts in Defender with the Purview Triage Agent view.
claims.quote: Set the toggle to the Triage Agent view. This view shows the alerts that have been triaged by the agent.
claims.fix: Replace "the Purview **Triage Agent** view" with "the Purview alert investigation experience". The already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-activities also says the unified Alerts (preview) experience removes the toggle, whereas get-started still describes it.

claims.claim: Support teams have no Microsoft guidance to point to for summaries in Defender.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Insider Risk Management" "agent summaries" "Defender"'; read Defender investigation and MC1438568. The absence of agent-summary content in that Learn article does not establish a universal absence of Microsoft guidance; the notice gives readiness recommendations.
claims.fix: Replace "Learn's Defender page has no agent-summary content yet, so support teams have no Microsoft guidance to point to for it" with "Learn's Defender page has no agent-summary content yet; MC1438568 provides Microsoft's rollout and readiness guidance".

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The governance checklist's instruction to check Defender and IRM role assignments has a corresponding control row.
claims.quote: Checklist: "Check who holds Security Operator, Security Reader and the IRM role groups". The table covers only data sharing, agent deactivation and usage monitoring.
claims.fix: The role-assignment check has no corresponding controls-table row. Remove that checklist bullet; the existing roles discussion in Risk assessment and Scope can remain.
